title: pilosella pinea
intro: Pilosella pinea, commonly known as False Fox-glove, is a flowering plant in the sunflower family (Asteraceae). It is valued for its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, making it useful in treating wounds and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Pilosella pinea include its ability to act as a vulnerary, an antiseptic, and an anti-inflammatory agent, making it effective in treating various health issues. The bioactive constituents of Pilosella pinea include sesquiterpene lactones, such as alantolactone and isoalantolactone, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
